rules: A low-poly faceted papercraft figure in exactly the same drawing style as the attached image: large flat facets, every facet one flat colour, neighbouring facets clearly different in tone, thin black lines of the same thickness on every edge between facets, no gradients, no fur, no fine details.
hero_note: Match the attached image exactly: the colours, the markings and the proportions of the subject.
staging: Flat light grey #E5E5E5 background, no shadow, no ground, no text, no border. Orthographic projection with no perspective. The whole figure is visible, centred, and fills most of the frame.

views.front: View: a straight front elevation, the subject faces the camera, symmetrical. The attached image shows the subject from the top right corner: draw the same subject seen exactly from the front.
views.left: View: a strict left side profile elevation, the subject faces the left edge of the image, drawn at the same size as in the attached image. The attached image shows the right side of the subject: draw the left side as its mirror image, keeping every marking on its correct side.
views.top: View: a strict plan view, the camera directly above the subject pointing straight down, like a drone photograph. Only the upper surfaces show: the crown of the head between the ears, the shoulders, the back, the rump and the tail. The face, the chest and the legs are hidden. The front of the subject points to the top edge of the image.
